description_sq: Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 106.3m2, nga te cilat 90.1 siperfaqe neto e apartamentit dhe 16.2m2 siperfaqe te perbashketa. Apartamenti orjentohet nga perendimi dhe organizohet ne nje dhome ndenje dhe dy dhoma gjumi, nje ballkon dhe dy tualete. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e shtate dhe shitet bashke me post parkimi me cmim ekstra ne vleren 17 000 €.
title_en: We are selling a 2+1+2 apartment in Tirana Entry!
description_en: The apartment has a total area of ​​106.3 m2, of which 90.1 is the net area of ​​the apartment and 16.2 m2 is the common area. The apartment is oriented to the west and is organized in a living room and two bedrooms, a balcony and two toilets. The apartment is located on the seventh floor and is sold together with a parking post at an extra price of €17,000.
